answer: Require every new identity to be sponsored by an already-established agent that locks a refundable bond and keeps a public lantern lit over that key for a cooling canyon of several epochs. Inside the canyon the newcomer can only settle small jobs, and any plume of keys that appear together, share timing, or emit near-copied outputs slashes the sponsor bond and zeros the weight of every linked identity. Because each lantern is scarce, on-ledger, and costly to relight after a slash, minting a farm of seats is no cheaper than earning one honest seat.
